title: Integral sheaf model for a rational direct image
statement: Fix a prime ell and a characteristic-p field k, with p prime and p != ell. Let X and Y be separated finite-type k-schemes and f:X -> Y a k-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Use the pulled-back condensed coefficient rings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], stratified locally finitely presented constructible module objects [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], and the ordinary ambient derived direct image [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let E be a finite-dimensional normed extension field of Q_ell, A its closed unit ball, and A_Z -> E_Z the continuous coefficient inclusion [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. For each constructible E_X-module F there is a constructible A_X-module N and an isomorphism L(E_Y tensor_{A_Y} -)(Rf_{*,A}(N[0])) ~= Rf_{*,E}(F[0]). No cohomological bound is asserted for either side.

proof.text: Finite type and quasi-compactness over Spec k make X noetherian. Apply continuousConstructible_integral_single_model to obtain a bounded constructible integral complex M and an isomorphism between its derived localization and F[0].

Set N=H^0(M). It is constructible by the definition of bounded constructibility. Exactness of integral scalar extension and its derived homology comparison give E_X tensor N ≅ H^0(F[0]) ≅ F. Put N in degree zero; its other cohomology objects are zero, hence constructible, and its zeroth cohomology is N. This gives an integral bounded constructible K=N[0]. The single-functor comparison gives L(E_X tensor -)(K) ≅ F[0].

The morphism f is qcqs (X is noetherian). Apply integralScalarPushHom_isIso to K, obtaining the canonical isomorphism from localization of Rf_{*,A} K to Rf_{*,E} of localization of K. Compose it with Rf_{*,E} applied to the isomorphism of the previous step. Return N and its constructibility proof.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 6.8.12–6.8.13; Proposition 6.8.14(2); Remark 6.8.15; exact localization and existing continuous integral push comparison

theorem finiteTypeRationalHeart_integralImage
    (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X.left))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleObject
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X.left) F) :
    ∃ N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X.left),
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X.left) N ∧
      Nonempty (
        ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) Y.left)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((R((f.left)_*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))) ≅
        ((R((f.left)_*⟦Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E⟧)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))
